entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner, learned counsel for the State and learned counsel for the Informant.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in connection with G.R No.33 of 2023 pending on the file of learned Addl. District Judge-cum-Special Court POCSO Act, Berhampur arising out of Sorada P.S. Case No.88 of 2023 for commission of offence alleged under Sections 376(2)(n)/376(3)/363/366/506 of IPC and r/w Sec. 6 of POCSO Act.

entities.text: Addl. District Judge-cum-Special Court POCSO Act, Berhampur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel, on instruction, submits that except the present BLAPL, no other bail application of the Petitioner relating to the aforementioned P.S. case is pending in any other Court.

4. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) by the learned ADJ-cum- Spl. Court under POCSO Act, Berhampur by order dated 23.08.2024 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
5. This Court perused the deposition of the victim on record as well as the medical examination report.
6. On consideration of the evidence and medical examination report, this Court is not inclined to entertain the bail application.

7. Learned Court in seisin is requested to expedite the trial.
8. Before parting with the case, this Court records its deep anguish that in spite of repeated directions by the Apex Court as well as this Court the name of the victim finds place in the deposition.

9. Registry is requested to serve copy of this order to the learned ADJ-cum-Spl. Court, POCSO Act,
Berhampur.
10. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.

(V. NARASINGH)
